findings.claim: Across the full observed score window (0.0-0.49), landmark_00 soft_mass shows a strong early positive rate (first_rate_z ~ +9.3) that reverses to a strong negative late rate (last_rate_z ~ -10.0), with 4 sign changes and 1 strong sign conflict; the whole-window level z is small (~0.64) and no polynomial was accepted (relative node RMSE ~0.29). This is a non-monotone, sign-reversing contrast rather than a stationary target.

landmark_00_local_dy has the largest early rate magnitude (first_rate_z ~ -72.4) decaying to a small positive late rate (last_rate_z ~ +5.5), with 6 sign changes and 4 strong sign conflicts; whole-window level z is small (~-0.30). The contrast is dominated by early-window motion, not a persistent offset.

landmark_00_local_dx shows a strong negative early rate (first_rate_z ~ -17.5) reversing to positive late rate (last_rate_z ~ +8.1) with 6 sign changes and 9 strong sign conflicts; whole-window level z is near zero (~-0.18).

landmark_00_local_cxy has the largest early positive rate (first_rate_z ~ +64.8) reversing to negative late rate (last_rate_z ~ -19.7) with 9 sign changes and 14 strong sign conflicts, the most conflicted landmark_00 feature; whole-window level z is small (~0.10).

landmark_00_local_dz and landmark_00_local_czz show early positive rates (+14.1 and +15.2) reversing to negative late rates (-2.4 and -6.3) with 10 and 7 sign changes respectively; both have small whole-window level z (~-0.02 and ~-0.31).
landmark_00_local_cyy and landmark_00_local_cxx show early negative rates (-36.5 and -7.9) reversing to positive late rates (+17.1 and +15.9); whole-window level z is small (~-0.58 for both).

landmark_00_local_cxz and landmark_00_local_cyz have small early rates (+8.8 and -16.4) and small late rates (+10.0 and +8.9) with 7 sign changes each; whole-window level z is small (~0.14 and ~-0.25).

The score clock runs over observed_score_times 0.0-0.49 with learning_window [0.0,0.5] and curve_support [0.0,0.49]; label semantics are 'Recorded affinities removed; equal score prior', so these are selection-time coordinate contrasts, not decoded final affinity or survival outcomes.

hypotheses.direction: increase early-window rate, decrease late-window rate
hypotheses.falsifier: No change in first_rate_z/last_rate_z sign pattern, or a new strong sign conflict appears at landmark_00 soft_mass.
hypotheses.scope: landmark_00 local region, full observed window 0.0-0.49
hypotheses.statement: If landmark_00 soft_mass is controlled toward its early-window positive rate and away from its late-window negative rate, the early-window contrast should be preserved while the late-window reversal is suppressed.

hypotheses.falsifier: first_rate_z magnitude does not decrease, or whole_window_z grows beyond its current small value.
hypotheses.statement: If landmark_00_local_dy is controlled to reduce the magnitude of its early negative rate, the dominant early-window motion contrast should weaken without introducing a persistent whole-window offset.

hypotheses.falsifier: strong_sign_conflicts does not decrease, or sign_changes remain at 9.
hypotheses.statement: If landmark_00_local_cxy is controlled to reduce its early positive rate, the most conflicted landmark_00 feature should show fewer strong sign conflicts.

limitations: Stage profiles and temporal profiles are unavailable; only continuous curves and trend tables were read.
No decoded final affinity or survival labels are present; all evidence is selection-time coordinate contrast, not descendant survival or measured final benefit.
Polynomial fits were not accepted for any landmark_00 feature (relative node RMSE 0.29-0.87), so trend shapes are descriptive, not extrapolatable.
The supplied continuous functions do not specify an absolute coordinate target or spatial gradient; no target is inferred from the rate contrasts.
Only landmark_00 features were queried; other landmarks were not inspected in this turn.
